firstOccurrence.englishText: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

timeline.evidenceText: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

definitions.full: H2238. Zeresh זֶ֫רֶשׁ proper name, feminine wife of Haman Est 5:10 , 14 ; 6:13 (twice in verse) (according to Opp Esth. 25 = Persian zaris , Zend zairis , la dorée , compare aurum ductile , Vull ii. 128 b ; Jen VOJ, 1892, 64 compare Elamite goddess Kiriša ).
